item.title: Johnson Wen deported & banned from re-entering S'pore for rushing Ariana Grande during Wicked premiere
item.description: Johnson Wen, who rushed Ariana Grande during the "Wicked: For Good" premiere, has been deported and banned from re-entering Singapore.

item.title: 72-year-old motorcyclist dies after accident with truck along SLE, driver assisting investigations
item.description: A 72-year-old motorcyclist died after being involved in an accident with a truck along the SLE. The truck driver is assisting investigations.

item.title: Youths allegedly steal fish from closed fishing pond in Pasir Ris, police investigating
item.description: The police are investigating after youths were caught allegedly stealing fish from a closed pond in Pasir Ris.

item.title: Power bank catches fire on Scoot flight from Hong Kong, extinguished by cabin crew
item.description: A power bank caught fire on a Scoot flight from Hong Kong and was extinguished by the cabin crew, the airline said.

item.title: Pilot in Lithuania forges qualifications to become captain, flies passengers across Europe for months
item.description: A Lithuanian airline is under scrutiny after a pilot allegedly flew as a captain on multiple flights for months using forged qualifications.

item.title: Power pole explodes after falling into raging floodwaters in Thailand
item.description: A power pole exploded at least twice after it fell into strong floodwaters following days of heavy rain in southern Thailand.

item.title: National Dental Centre photographer secretly takes 600 chest photos of female patients he 'found attractive'
item.description: A National Dental Centre Photographer took over 600 chest photos of about 25 female patients, targeting patients he found attractive.

item.title: 8 S'poreans miss return flight after severe flooding in Thailand traps them in Hat Yai hotel
item.description: Heavy rain and severe flooding trapped eight Singaporeans in a hotel in Hat Yai, Thailand, causing them to miss their return flight.

item.title: Woman found dead in Taiwan home after company flags water usage of over 6,000 kilolitres in 2 months
item.description: An 82-year-old woman in Taiwan was found dead in her home after her water usage was found to have exceeded 6,000 kilolitres in two months.

item.title: Neighbours work together to fight Sembawang HDB unit fire using water hose before police arrive
item.description: A Sembawang HDB flat fire allegedly broke out due to a power bank, with neighbours rallying to try to extinguish it with a hose.
